name: PLC_HEARTBEAT
description: increments every 100 ms cycle; edge alarms if frozen 3 s

name: PLC_MODE
description: low byte 0 off 1 auto 2 manual 3 test 4 fault; bit 8 = LITE (RevPi software controller)

name: PLC_PROJECT_CRC
description: CRC-16 of loaded project; edge compares with commissioned value (attested)

name: EDGE_WATCHDOG
description: edge writes rising counter every 1 s; PLC sets EDGE_LOST when unchanged 30 s

name: EDGE_LOST
description: 1 = PLC on its own setpoints; edge trim ignored

name: SUPPLY_TRIM_x10
description: edge supply setpoint trim -20..+20; clamped; ignored when EDGE_LOST

name: TEST_REQUEST
description: 0 none 1 failover sweep 2 UPS ride-through 3 generator exercise; accepted only in AUTO with no alarm; cleared by PLC

name: COOL_CMD
description: bit n = cooling unit n+1 commanded run

name: COOL_RUN
description: bit n = unit n+1 run feedback

name: COOL_FAULT
description: bit n = unit n+1 fault (contact or comms loss)

name: COOL_LEAD
description: index 1..N of current lead unit (weekly rotation)

name: COOL_N_REQUIRED
description: units required for current load incl. redundancy

name: LEAK_ZONE
description: bit n = hardwired leak zone n+1 wet (SeaHawk)

name: ISO_VALVE_CMD
description: bit n = isolation valve n+1 commanded closed

name: ISO_VALVE_CLOSED
description: bit n = valve n+1 closed limit switch

name: ISO_VALVE_FAULT
description: bit n = valve did not reach limit within 30 s

name: CDU_PUMP_STOP
description: 1 = PLC stopped CDU pumps (leak in zone whose valve failed)

name: DOOR_OPEN_S
description: seconds longest-open door has been open

name: FIRE_PANEL
description: bit0 alarm bit1 trouble bit2 released bit3 supervisory (aux contacts; monitor only)

name: GEN_STATE
description: 0 off 1 starting 2 running 3 cooldown 4 fault 5 not ready

name: RTD_01_x100
description: Pt1000 string input 1 (AXL F RTD4) -> plcN T_in_1

name: AI_01_uA
description: 4-20 mA input 1 (AXL F AI4 I 1H) -> plcN ai0_mA

name: ALARM_WORD
description: bit0 cooling capacity lost 1 all units faulted 2 leak isolation 3 valve fault 4 door>5min 5 EPO open 6 fire alarm 7 gen fault 8 ATS on gen 9 edge lost 10 PSU redundancy lost 11 24V UPS on battery
